Class CraftTweakerInspection

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerInspection
public final class CraftTweakerInspection extends Object
Detached glyph/style view for editor integrations; all offsets are UTF-16 source positions.
